{{Quote|CT-3632 to CT-3636, no activity detected.|CT-3632 reports in during patrol|<ref name="Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''CT-3632''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] after an [[Vaklin insurgency|Insurgency]] rose up against the Empire there due to three members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Twelve [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the second of the Jedi who had helped start the insurgence was defeated, CT-3632 was part of a patrol lead by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], which included two enforcer squads of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], a [[TX-130 Fighter Tank]], at least one [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]] and a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]]. The squad set out at 0700 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] local time, with the intention of capturing or [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Cho'na Bene]], another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who helped start the insurgency. CT-3632 was given the task of perimeter patrol ahead of the main group during the patrol, and as the patrol entered the area known as the [[Howling Ruins]], he reported that he had found no activity to [[CT-3636]], another member clone trooper in the group. 3636 told 3632 to change the perimeter sweep to seventy [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and stay cautious, after which the patrol was [[Ambush in the Howling Ruins|ambushed]] by Bene and the [[Vaklin insurgents|insurgents]]. Twelve of the troopers in the patrol, including 3636 were killed in the following battle, with the rest falling back to the command center afterwards.
